scope: 73 newly recognized components (50 Abilities, 23 attacks), 69 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Squawkabilly ex
sources.checkedFacts: Discard hand and draw six is restricted to the controller first turn and one named Ability per turn.

sources.title: Crobat V and Dedenne-GX official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Dedechange discards the hand and draws six; Dark Asset fills the hand to six on hand-to-Bench entry.

sources.title: Independent named draw groups
sources.checkedFacts: Dedechange and Dark Asset could both be used in the same turn; another copy of the same named Ability remains limited.

sources.title: Fezandipiti ex
sources.checkedFacts: Draw three only after one of the controller Pokemon was Knocked Out during the opponent previous turn; one Flip the Script per turn.

sources.title: Checkup KO distinction
sources.checkedFacts: A Burn KO between turns does not qualify for Flip the Script.

boundaries: Named TURN usage groups are owned by each player and remain used across multiple source instances or leaving/reentering play. Different names have independent groups.
First-own-turn qualification checks completed own turns, preserving both starting seats and rejecting extra own turns.
Hand-entry actions remain optional and require HAND source; opening setup does not trigger them. Declining does not consume the named group.
Draw-until only draws the missing cards; whole-hand discard is not a mandatory nonempty hand cost.
Search categories, printed type/HP, privacy and fail-to-find rules remain explicit. Any-card search takes at least one when possible.
Opponent-turn KO history excludes Checkup; attack bonus retains the separate attack-damage requirement.
No prior supported program or card metadata changes; artwork excluded.
